subject: Lifestyle Changes Cut Risk of Multiple Chronic Conditions in Prediabetes
script: From Agewell Brief: Lifestyle Changes Cut Risk of Multiple Chronic Conditions in Prediabetes. A long-term NIH trial found lifestyle intervention reduced risk of developing several chronic diseases, while metformin showed no difference from placebo. Lifestyle intervention lowered risk of multiple chronic conditions in adults with prediabetes. Read the full source-linked dispatch and primary study caveats at AgewellBrief.com.
